The status word is the first word of the ADR's `Status:` field. `Relations` come from that field (`amends`, `amended by`, `supersedes`, `superseded by`). `First named in` is the oldest release note under `docs/releases/` that mentions the ADR; it is a pointer, not proof that the ADR shipped. `proposed` on an older ADR usually means nobody promoted it, not that it is open.
